Changelog:
# Should I? v1.1.0

The first unified **Should I?** live release.

## Should I Sell?
Keeps the existing selling analysis, live refresh, stack guidance, current-listing audit, vendor economics, and personal sales history.

## Should I Buy?
Adds budget-aware Universalis opportunity discovery, deep listing/history analysis, market and vendor arbitrage, split/consolidate detection, risk-adjusted scoring, holding-time estimates, portfolio allocation, and LIVE VERIFY against fresh FFXIV Market Board data.

## Should I Tycoon?
Adds confirmed Market Board purchase capture, FIFO cost basis, realized/unrealized analytics, item and strategy performance, trader-profile analysis, and prediction-vs-reality calibration.

This release is being promoted directly for live single-tester validation. Recommendations remain read-only and Should I? never automatically purchases Market Board listings.
